name: Interview to Book / 故事成书
tagline: Interviews a life story question by question and binds it into a book
description: Choose a life arc and it interviews someone one question at a time, taking typed, spoken or filmed answers. The responses are then shaped into a print-ready memoir, cover included, instead of a folder of transcripts. Built to preserve a parent's recollections, and tested end to end on the sharer himself first.
author: jackhu_bangzhu
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
